name: learning-organizers
description: Build and edit graphic organizers and learning tools: T-charts, weighted attribute matrices, flow charts, mind maps, concept maps, K-W-L charts, anticipation guides, action plans, structured notes, assessment checklists, rubrics, self-questioning sheets and whole-lesson handout kits. Each is one YAML spec rendered by Typst into a printable PDF, a PNG and a live picture in the terminal through cc-intelligent-ui, with an answer key and a learner version (writing space where the answers were) from the same spec. Grounded in the FHWA NHI LearnersFirst instructor handbook. Two skills (graphic-organizer, lesson-kit), a stdlib-only CLI and a mutation-checked self-test. No agents.
